senses: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.38;
one of David's officers, a Gederite, who had the superintendence of his olive and sycamore plantations

strongs.def: Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite
strongs.from: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2603 (חָנַן); possessor of grace
